answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Activation features match fine-tuned and rule out the other categories. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.084 (fine-tuned 0.086–0.092, quantized 0.096–0.105). L2 grows to 0.414 at layer 32 with a +0.117 final-layer jump, versus quantized ~0.25 and +0.02. The mid-layer size ratio is 1.021 (fine-tuned 1.017–1.023), and the internal state grows rather than shrinks as in quantized. Direction consistency is 0.705 and effective rank 3.12, both in the fine-tuned range. Final cosine is 0.906, and raw-score shift ÷ TV is 11.5, near the top of the fine-tuned range. The layer-2 spike is only 0.1, so system-prompted (31.7–64) is ruled out. Median first divergence of 10 and edit distance of 0.531 look more like quantized, but they overlap with fine-tuned ranges, and the activation signature is decisive. Base is excluded because every difference is non-zero.
